'''J. Holt Kernodle Holt's Imperial Star Fleet''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[J. Holt Kernodle]]
* '''Published:''' July 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - A New Hope]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Docking Bay 327|Premiere-D-deathstardockingbay327.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Holt's Imperial Star Fleet
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PANH Holt's Imperial Star Fleet Kernodle.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Here's the KEY to the WHOLE DECK: Dantooine. At any time during your opponent's turn, you can move your starships there as a react. If he deploys 3 Corellian Corvettes against your one ISD, react to Dantooine. Repeat Ad Infinitum, making sure you laugh maniacally each time you zip out of his Starships' scopes!

== Strategy ==

1. Start with Kessel, so that your ships are all deploy -1.

2. Get Tarkin to Kessel as soon as possible; this makes all of your ships deploy -2. After your fleet is shaping up, get Tarkin on to the ground so that your stormtroopers can deploy for free.

3. Save your force and deploy starships at least four at a time (so you can get a destiny draw) OR put a pilot on a ship for added ability.

4. If you're getting a lot of resistance in space, add DS-61-2 / DS-61-3 to a Star Destroyer to get power and ability. (One star destroyer with both wingmen on it is power 14!)

5. Use the Trooper Guard to aid in defending the point where you are massing your stormtroopers; try to mass your troops at the Death Star docking bay so that they can move for free to another docking bay.

I've Lost Artoo: Move a big fleet onto a poorly defended system. If you've played this card, one of your opponent's ships won't be able to run and hide! (This is good to play on a Y-wing where you will move 2-3 Star Destroyers!)

Lateral Damage: Deploy on a system where you have LOTS of power. Target a Corvette or Mellenium Falcon.

Dark Maneuvers: Use these 2-4 AT ONCE in combination with a Tallon Roll to rid yourself of the Falcon, or a hot-shot X-Wing.

Full Scale Alert: Use as you would use I've Lost Artoo.
